venue.name: Fairway Gorge Paddling Club
venue.description: Fairway Gorge Paddling Club is a paddling club on the Gorge waterway at 2940 Jutland Road in Victoria, offering dragon boat, outrigger canoe, kayak and stand-up paddleboard programs. Through its Group Adventures page it takes bookings from classrooms, workplaces, social groups and sports teams for guided dragon boat and ocean kayak sessions, and can accommodate groups of 10 to 120 people for one-time or multi-session bookings. FGPC supplies the coaches, guides, PFDs, paddles and safety equipment. It also runs summer Paddlesport Adventure Camps for children aged 6 to 12 and a youth sprint kayak club.
restrictions: Corporate dragon boat crews are expected to have a minimum of 60% of their paddlers from the registering organization.
venue.hours_notes: Boat house / office / administration: Weekends 9AM - 4PM; Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 9AM - 7:30PM; Wednesday 9AM - 8:30PM; Friday 9AM - 5:30PM. Regular hours on holidays unless noted.
venue.seasonal_notes: "The summers fill up fast, so we encourage groups to book as early as they can for the best date selections."

programs.name: Dragon Boat Group Adventure
programs.description: A one-and-a-half hour dragon boat session for a booked group, with an FGPC coach and steersperson supplied along with all paddling and safety equipment. Cost is $350 per boat; a boat takes a minimum of 16 and a maximum of 20 paddlers, and up to 5 boats can be booked for one session. The same $350 per boat rate is published for both general guided groups and guided school groups. School bookings require at least one adult chaperone or teacher for every ten participants. Whether the rate includes GST is not stated.
programs.what_children_do: Each child takes a paddle and a lifejacket, sits in a 20-seat dragon boat with a coach and a steersperson, and paddles together as a crew on the water for an hour and a half.
programs.our_note: The boat needs 16 paddlers minimum, so a class of 25 either splits across two boats at $350 each or pads the crew with adults. The site never says the youngest age it will take in a dragon boat - ask, because this is a real boat on open water, not a pool.
programs.practical_summary: Everything on the water is supplied - boat, paddles, lifejackets, coach and steersperson - and school groups need one adult per ten children. Washrooms, an indoor lunch space, a rain plan and a minimum age are all unstated, so confirm those when you book.

programs.name: Ocean Kayak Group Adventure
programs.description: A two-hour guided ocean kayak session for a booked group at $35 per person. The minimum number of paddlers is 6 and the maximum is 29, and FGPC provides one guide for every 10 to 12 registrants plus all paddling and safety equipment. Guides provide safety coverage and accompany groups at all times. The same $35 per person rate is published for general guided groups and for guided school groups; school bookings require one adult chaperone or teacher for every ten participants. Whether the rate includes GST is not stated.
programs.what_children_do: Children put on a lifejacket, get into a kayak with a paddle and stay on the water for two hours with FGPC guides alongside them the whole time.
programs.our_note: Two hours in a kayak is a long stretch for younger children and there is no published minimum age - ask what the youngest paddler they will take is before you plan around it. Budget one adult per ten children as the club requires, and assume everyone comes off the water wet.
programs.practical_summary: Kayaks, paddles and lifejackets are supplied and a guide stays with every 10 to 12 paddlers. Washrooms, changing space, indoor lunch space and a wet-weather plan are not stated on the site - worth a call.

programs.name: Paddlesport Adventure Camp (ages 6 to 12)
programs.description: A summer day camp for children in two age groups, 6 to 9 and 10 to 12, covering ocean kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, outrigger canoeing and beginner racing kayaks, plus water safety, self rescue, team challenges and an end-of-week mini regatta. Camps run weekdays 9am to 4pm. 2026 fees are $352 for a 4 day camp and $440 for a 5 day camp; the $440 five-day rate is recorded here. Registration is per child through the online store rather than as a group booking. Eight camp weeks ran in July and August 2026.
programs.what_children_do: Children spend the week on the water trying ocean kayaks, paddleboards, outrigger canoes and racing kayaks, learning how to fit a lifejacket and self rescue, playing paddle games and relay races, and finishing with a mini regatta.
programs.our_note: This is per-child registration through the club's store, not a group booking, so a daycare sending several children pays and registers each one separately. Days run 9am to 4pm, and a weekly pizza lunch is provided in partnership with a local pizza shop - check what else children need to bring.
programs.practical_summary: Full weekdays 9am to 4pm on the water, tax exempt, with a weekly pizza lunch included. Washrooms, changing space, wet-weather plans and staff-to-child ratios are not published - ask before you commit.
programs.extra_fees_note: Paddle sports camps are tax exempt. 4 day camps are $352.00 and 5 day camps are $440.00.
programs.cancellation_note: To withdraw from any camp, participants must give notice at least one week prior to the program start date. Refunds subject to a 15% administrative fee.
programs.evidence: Prices range from $352 to $440 per week.
